"""Run the full native time-marching experiment and save its plots."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import torch

from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    response,
)

from .approximation import REAL
from .workflow import SHOTS, Result, run


def print_report(result: Result) -> None:
    print(
        "Phase counts:",
        tuple(
            int(x.numel())
            for x in (
                result.exponential.even_fit.phases,
                result.exponential.odd_fit.phases,
                result.amplifier.phase_fit.phases,
            )
        ),
    )
    print("Scalar demonstration maximum error:", result.scalar_fit_error)
    print(
        "Amplifier interval error and maximum polynomial magnitude:",
        result.amplifier.interval_error,
        result.amplifier.maximum_magnitude,
    )
    print("Maximum Magnus block error:", result.magnus_block_error)
    print("Draws per circuit:", SHOTS)
    for label, march in (("Naive", result.naive), ("Amplified", result.amplified)):
        print(label + " counts:", march.accepted_counts)
        print(label + " success probability:", march.exact_prob)
        print(label + " normalized error:", march.normalized_error)
        print(label + " state error:", march.state_error)
        print(
            label + " resources:",
            march.resources.n_qubits,
            march.resources.n_operations,
            march.resources.depth,
        )
    print("Analytic final state:", result.classical[-1].tolist())


def save_figures(result: Result, directory: Path) -> None:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.4), layout="constrained")
    for index in range(4):
        axes[0].plot(
            result.times.tolist(),
            result.classical[:, index].tolist(),
            label=f"Coordinate {index}",
        )
    axes[0].set(xlabel="Time", ylabel="Amplitude", title="Analytic diagonal evolution")
    axes[0].legend()
    exact = result.classical[-1] / result.classical[-1].norm()
    naive = result.naive.sampled_magnitudes / result.naive.sampled_magnitudes.norm()
    amplified = (
        result.amplified.sampled_magnitudes / result.amplified.sampled_magnitudes.norm()
    )
    bar_axes = torch.arange(4, dtype=REAL)
    for offset, values, label in (
        (-0.24, exact, "Analytic"),
        (0.0, naive, "Naive samples"),
        (0.24, amplified, "Amplified samples"),
    ):
        axes[1].bar(
            (bar_axes + offset).tolist(), values.tolist(), width=0.22, label=label
        )
    axes[1].set(
        xlabel="Coordinate",
        ylabel="Normalized amplitude",
        title="Counter-zero sample reconstruction",
    )
    axes[1].set_xticks(range(4))
    axes[1].legend()
    figure.savefig(directory / "time-marching.png", dpi=140)
    plt.close(figure)

    figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.4), layout="constrained")
    x = torch.linspace(-1, 1, 1000, dtype=REAL)
    demo = 0.5 * (
        response(x, result.demo.even_fit.phases)
        + response(x, result.demo.odd_fit.phases)
    )
    axes[0].plot(x.tolist(), demo.tolist(), label="Degree 7 and 6 responses")
    axes[0].plot(
        x.tolist(),
        (0.5 * (2 * (x - 1)).exp()).tolist(),
        "--",
        label="Scaled exponential",
    )
    axes[0].set(
        xlabel="Signal value",
        ylabel="Selected amplitude",
        title="Exponential approximation",
    )
    axes[0].legend()
    y = response(x, result.amplifier.phase_fit.phases)
    axes[1].plot(x.tolist(), y.tolist(), label="Bounded degree 7 response")
    interval = x[x.abs() <= 0.5]
    axes[1].plot(
        interval.tolist(), (1.8 * interval).tolist(), "--", label="Target interval"
    )
    axes[1].set(
        xlabel="Signal value",
        ylabel="Selected amplitude",
        title="Amplification approximation",
    )
    axes[1].legend()
    figure.savefig(directory / "time-polynomials.png", dpi=140)
    plt.close(figure)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--figures", type=Path, default=Path("time-marching-figures"))
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    result = run()
    print_report(result)
    save_figures(result, arguments.figures)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Run both native integrators and retain their finite postselection outcomes."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    response,
)
from flagquantum.compiler import ResourceEstimate, estimate_resources

from .approximation import (
    REAL,
    Amplifier,
    Exponential,
    amplitude_polynomial,
    exponential,
    physical_phases,
)
from .quantum import END, SLICE_COUNT, assemble, build_slice, exact_ode, expected_block
from .reference import reference_state

SHOTS = 1_000_000


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class March:
    resources: ResourceEstimate
    state_error: float
    exact_prob: float
    accepted_counts: tuple[int, ...]
    sampled_magnitudes: torch.Tensor
    normalized_error: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Result:
    times: torch.Tensor
    classical: torch.Tensor
    demo: Exponential
    exponential: Exponential
    amplifier: Amplifier
    scalar_fit_error: float
    magnus_block_error: float
    naive: March
    amplified: March


def march(
    circuit: fq.Circuit,
    expected: torch.Tensor,
    normalized_classical: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    seed: int,
) -> March:
    resources = estimate_resources(circuit)
    if resources.n_qubits != 11 or resources.n_operations > 200_000:
        raise ValueError("The original-sized integrator exceeded its resource budget")
    state: torch.Tensor = circuit.state().flatten()
    error = float((state - expected).abs().max())
    if error > 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("The complete state disagrees with the independent integrator")
    joint = state.reshape(4, 64, 8).abs().square().sum(dim=1)
    success = float(joint[:, 0].sum())
    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    observed = torch.multinomial(
        joint.flatten(), SHOTS, replacement=True, generator=generator
    )
    counts = torch.bincount(observed, minlength=32).reshape(4, 8)
    accepted = counts[:, 0]
    amplitudes = (accepted.to(REAL) / SHOTS).sqrt()
    if int(accepted.sum()) == 0:
        raise ValueError("The finite run did not observe a completed path")
    norm = amplitudes.norm()
    difference = float((amplitudes / norm - normalized_classical).norm())
    return March(
        resources,
        error,
        success,
        tuple(int(v) for v in accepted),
        amplitudes,
        difference,
    )


def run() -> Result:
    times = torch.linspace(0, END, 100, dtype=REAL)
    classical = exact_ode(times)
    demo = exponential(2)
    approximation = exponential(END / SLICE_COUNT)
    amplifier = amplitude_polynomial()
    even = physical_phases(approximation.even_fit)
    odd = physical_phases(approximation.odd_fit)
    amp = physical_phases(amplifier.phase_fit)
    slices = tuple(
        build_slice(i / 2, (i + 1) / 2, even, odd) for i in range(SLICE_COUNT)
    )
    maximum_block_error = 0.0
    for index, segment in enumerate(slices):
        circuit = fq.Circuit(7, dtype=torch.complex128).h(0).h(1).compose(segment)
        projected = 2 * circuit.state().reshape(4, 32)[:, 0]
        target = expected_block(index / 2, (index + 1) / 2)
        expected = 0.5 * (
            response(target, approximation.even_fit.phases)
            + response(target, approximation.odd_fit.phases)
        )
        maximum_block_error = max(
            maximum_block_error, float((projected - expected).abs().max())
        )
    if maximum_block_error > 1e-10:
        raise ValueError(
            "The Magnus projector blocks must realize the fitted polynomial"
        )
    dense = torch.linspace(-1, 1, 4097, dtype=REAL)
    fitted = response(dense, demo.even_fit.phases) + response(
        dense, demo.odd_fit.phases
    )
    scalar_fit_error = float((fitted - (2 * (dense - 1)).exp()).abs().max() / 2)

    normalized = classical[-1] / classical[-1].norm()
    naive = march(
        assemble(slices, None), reference_state(even, odd, None), normalized, seed=1725
    )
    amplified = march(
        assemble(slices, amp), reference_state(even, odd, amp), normalized, seed=1726
    )
    if amplified.normalized_error >= 0.1 or amplified.exact_prob <= naive.exact_prob:
        raise ValueError(
            "Amplified time marching does not meet the source accuracy outcome"
        )
    return Result(
        times,
        classical,
        demo,
        approximation,
        amplifier,
        scalar_fit_error,
        maximum_block_error,
        naive,
        amplified,
    )

"""Fit the original short-slice exponential and amplification polynomials."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

from examples.synthesis.algorithms.hamiltonian_simulation.hamiltonian_simulation_with_block_encoding.hamiltonian_simulation_qsvt.overview.even_phases import (
    fit_even,
)
from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    PhaseFit,
    fit,
)

REAL = torch.float64
COMPLEX = torch.complex128
EXP_DEGREE = 7
AMP_DEGREE = 7


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Exponential:
    even: torch.Tensor
    odd: torch.Tensor
    even_fit: PhaseFit
    odd_fit: PhaseFit


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Amplifier:
    coefficients: torch.Tensor
    phase_fit: PhaseFit
    interval_error: float
    maximum_magnitude: float


def exponential(time: float) -> Exponential:
    """Recompute both Chebyshev parities by cosine projection."""
    nodes = math.pi * (torch.arange(128, dtype=REAL) + 0.5) / 128
    x = nodes.cos()
    evaluation = torch.cos(nodes[:, None] * torch.arange(EXP_DEGREE + 1, dtype=REAL))
    coefficients = (2 / nodes.numel()) * evaluation.T @ (time * (x - 1)).exp()
    coefficients[0] /= 2
    even = coefficients[::2].contiguous()
    odd = coefficients[1::2].contiguous()
    return Exponential(even, odd, fit_even(even), fit(odd))


def odd_features(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    phases = torch.acos(x.clamp(-1, 1))
    return torch.cos(phases[:, None] * torch.arange(1, AMP_DEGREE + 1, 2, dtype=REAL))


def amplitude_polynomial() -> Amplifier:
    """Minimize the error on [0, 1/2] with bounded magnitude on [0, 1]."""
    x = torch.linspace(0, 0.5, 1025, dtype=REAL)
    span = torch.linspace(0, math.pi / 2, 2049, dtype=REAL).cos()
    local, global_design = odd_features(x), odd_features(span)
    target = 1.8 * x
    slack_column = -torch.ones((x.numel(), 1), dtype=REAL)
    zeros = torch.zeros((span.numel(), 1), dtype=REAL)
    constraints = torch.cat(
        (
            torch.cat((local, slack_column), dim=1),
            torch.cat((-local, slack_column), dim=1),
            torch.cat((global_design, zeros), dim=1),
            torch.cat((-global_design, zeros), dim=1),
        )
    )
    caps = torch.full_like(span, 0.999)
    upper = torch.cat((target, -target, caps, caps))
    guess = torch.zeros(local.shape[1] + 1, dtype=REAL)
    guess[-1] = 1.25
    cost = torch.zeros_like(guess)
    cost[-1] = 1

    for exponent in range(1, 11):
        mu = 10.0**-exponent
        for _ in range(48):
            room = upper - constraints @ guess
            scaled = constraints / room[:, None]
            gradient = cost + mu * scaled.sum(dim=0)
            direction = torch.linalg.solve(mu * (scaled.T @ scaled), -gradient)
            descent = float(gradient @ direction)
            if -descent < 1e-13:
                break
            value = float(guess[-1] - mu * room.log().sum())
            scale = 1.0
            for _ in range(64):
                trial = guess + scale * direction
                remaining = upper - constraints @ trial
                if bool((remaining > 0).all()):
                    if (
                        float(trial[-1] - mu * remaining.log().sum())
                        <= value + 0.01 * scale * descent
                    ):
                        guess = trial
                        break
                scale *= 0.5
            else:
                raise ValueError("Amplifier fitting lost its feasible search direction")
    coefficients = guess[:-1]
    probe = torch.linspace(0, 1, 16_385, dtype=REAL)
    values = odd_features(probe) @ coefficients
    maximum = float(values.abs().max())
    error = float((values[:8193] - 1.8 * probe[:8193]).abs().max())
    if maximum >= 1 or error > 0.1:
        raise ValueError("The degree-seven amplification polynomial must stay bounded")
    return Amplifier(coefficients, fit(coefficients), error, maximum)


def physical_phases(fitted: PhaseFit) -> tuple[float, ...]:
    """Express the imaginary Wx response as a real alternating RY block sequence."""
    angles = fitted.phases.clone()
    angles[0] -= math.pi / 2
    for j in range(2, len(angles), 2):
        angles[j - 1] -= math.pi / 2
        angles[j] += math.pi / 2
    return tuple(float(value) for value in angles)

"""Fit odd symmetric QSP phases to a fresh Chebyshev series."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

DTYPE = torch.float64
CTYPE = torch.complex128


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PhaseFit:
    phases: torch.Tensor
    residual: float
    iterations: int


def signal(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    w = x.to(CTYPE)
    y = 1j * (1 - x.square()).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
    return torch.stack((w, y, y, w), dim=-1).reshape(-1, 2, 2)


def values_and_derivative(
    w: torch.Tensor, half: torch.Tensor
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    rotation = torch.diag_embed(
        torch.stack(((1j * half).exp(), (-1j * half).exp()), dim=-1)
    )
    product = [rotation[j] @ w for j in range(half.numel())]
    product[-1] = rotation[-1].expand(w.size(0), -1, -1)
    identity = torch.eye(2, dtype=CTYPE).expand(w.size(0), -1, -1)
    prefix = [identity]
    for factor in product:
        prefix.append(prefix[-1] @ factor)
    left = prefix[-1]
    right = w @ left.transpose(-1, -2)
    result = (left @ right)[:, 0, 0].imag
    deriv = []
    suffix = right
    generator = torch.diag(torch.tensor([1j, -1j], dtype=CTYPE))
    for j in range(half.numel() - 1, -1, -1):
        suffix = product[j] @ suffix
        deriv.append(2 * (prefix[j] @ generator @ suffix)[:, 0, 0].imag)
    return result, torch.stack(list(reversed(deriv)), dim=1)


def response(x: torch.Tensor, angles: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    w = signal(x)
    phases = torch.diag_embed(
        torch.stack(((1j * angles).exp(), (-1j * angles).exp()), dim=-1)
    )
    out = phases[0]
    for rotation in phases[1:]:
        out = out @ w @ rotation
    value: torch.Tensor = out[:, 0, 0].imag
    return value


def fit(coefficients: torch.Tensor) -> PhaseFit:
    extent = coefficients.numel()
    nodes = math.pi * (torch.arange(extent, dtype=DTYPE) + 0.5) / (2 * extent)
    orders = torch.arange(1, 2 * extent, 2, dtype=DTYPE)
    w = signal(torch.cos(nodes))
    target = torch.cos(nodes[:, None] * orders) @ coefficients
    theta = torch.zeros_like(orders)
    iteration = 0
    while iteration < 12:
        samples, jacobian = values_and_derivative(w, theta)
        residual = target - samples
        if float(residual.abs().max()) < 1e-12:
            break
        theta += torch.linalg.solve(jacobian, residual)
        iteration += 1
    physical = torch.cat((theta, theta.flip((0,))))
    angles = torch.linspace(0, math.pi, 4097, dtype=DTYPE)
    x = angles.cos()
    error = float(
        (response(x, physical) - torch.cos(angles[:, None] * orders) @ coefficients)
        .abs()
        .max()
    )
    if error >= 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("The fresh QSP sequence must verify on the dense grid")
    return PhaseFit(physical, error, iteration)

"""Fit the even symmetric branch for the Jacobi–Anger cosine response."""

import math

import torch

from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    CTYPE,
    DTYPE,
    PhaseFit,
    response,
    signal,
)


def evaluate(w: torch.Tensor, half: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    rotations = torch.diag_embed(
        torch.stack(((1j * half).exp(), (-1j * half).exp()), dim=-1)
    )
    products = [rotation @ w for rotation in rotations[:-1]]
    identity = torch.eye(2, dtype=CTYPE).expand(w.size(0), -1, -1)
    prefix = [identity]
    for product in products:
        prefix.append(prefix[-1] @ product)
    left = prefix[-1]
    right = rotations[-1] @ left.transpose(-1, -2)
    values = (left @ right)[:, 0, 0].imag
    generator = torch.diag(torch.tensor([1j, -1j], dtype=CTYPE))
    derivatives = [(left @ generator @ right)[:, 0, 0].imag]
    suffix = right
    for i in range(len(products) - 1, -1, -1):
        suffix = products[i] @ suffix
        derivatives.append(2 * (prefix[i] @ generator @ suffix)[:, 0, 0].imag)
    return values, torch.stack(list(reversed(derivatives)), dim=1)


def fit_even(coefficients: torch.Tensor) -> PhaseFit:
    count = coefficients.numel()
    orders = torch.arange(0, 2 * count, 2, dtype=DTYPE)
    samples = math.pi * (torch.arange(count, dtype=DTYPE) + 0.5) / (2 * count)
    w = signal(samples.cos())
    target = torch.cos(samples[:, None] * orders) @ coefficients
    half = torch.zeros_like(orders)
    steps = 0
    while steps < 16:
        values, jacobian = evaluate(w, half)
        difference = target - values
        if float(difference.abs().max()) < 1e-12:
            break
        half += torch.linalg.solve(jacobian, difference)
        steps += 1
    phases = torch.cat((half, half[:-1].flip((0,))))
    theta = torch.linspace(0, math.pi, 4097, dtype=DTYPE)
    error = float(
        (
            response(theta.cos(), phases)
            - torch.cos(theta[:, None] * orders) @ coefficients
        )
        .abs()
        .max()
    )
    if error >= 1e-10:
        raise ValueError(
            "The fresh cosine phases must verify against the even polynomial"
        )
    return PhaseFit(phases, error, steps)

"""Independent controlled-Y, projector permutations and counter permutations."""

import cmath
import math

import torch

import flagquantum as fq

from ..data import EVEN_PHASES, ODD_PHASES

Gate = tuple[tuple[int, ...], torch.Tensor]


def direct_sum(left: torch.Tensor, right: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    n, m = left.shape[0], right.shape[0]
    result = torch.zeros((n + m, n + m), dtype=torch.complex128)
    result[:n, :n], result[n:, n:] = left, right
    return result


def rotation(angle: float) -> torch.Tensor:
    c, s = math.cos(angle / 2), math.sin(angle / 2)
    return torch.tensor([[c, -s], [s, c]], dtype=torch.complex128)


def short_gates(a: float, b: float, selected: bool = False) -> list[Gate]:
    h = torch.tensor([[1, 1], [1, -1]], dtype=torch.complex128) / math.sqrt(2)
    gates: list[Gate] = []
    for wire in (2, 3):
        gates.append(
            ((6, wire), direct_sum(torch.eye(2, dtype=torch.complex128), h))
            if selected
            else ((wire,), h)
        )
    gates.append(
        ((6, 4), direct_sum(torch.eye(2, dtype=torch.complex128), rotation(2 * a)))
        if selected
        else ((4,), rotation(2 * a))
    )
    for wire, angle in ((3, (b - a) / 2), (2, b - a), (1, 2.0), (0, 4.0)):
        matrix = direct_sum(torch.eye(2, dtype=torch.complex128), rotation(angle))
        gates.append(
            ((6, wire, 4), direct_sum(torch.eye(4, dtype=torch.complex128), matrix))
            if selected
            else ((wire, 4), matrix)
        )
    for wire in (2, 3):
        gates.append(
            ((6, wire), direct_sum(torch.eye(2, dtype=torch.complex128), h))
            if selected
            else ((wire,), h)
        )
    return gates


def projected_gates(even: float, odd: float) -> list[Gate]:
    projector = torch.eye(16, dtype=torch.complex128)
    projector[[0, 1]] = projector[[1, 0]]
    diagonal = torch.tensor(
        [cmath.exp(1j * angle * sign / 2) for angle in (even, odd) for sign in (-1, 1)],
        dtype=torch.complex128,
    )
    return [
        ((2, 3, 4, 5), projector),
        ((6, 5), torch.diag(diagonal)),
        ((2, 3, 4, 5), projector),
    ]


def step_gates(
    a: float,
    b: float,
    even: tuple[float, ...] = EVEN_PHASES,
    odd: tuple[float, ...] = ODD_PHASES,
) -> list[Gate]:
    h = torch.tensor([[1, 1], [1, -1]], dtype=torch.complex128) / math.sqrt(2)
    gates: list[Gate] = [((6,), rotation(math.pi / 2)), ((5,), h)]
    gates.extend(projected_gates(even[0], odd[0]))
    for index in range(3):
        forward = short_gates(a, b)
        gates.extend(forward)
        gates.extend(projected_gates(even[2 * index + 1], odd[2 * index + 1]))
        gates.extend((wires, matrix.mH) for wires, matrix in reversed(forward))
        gates.extend(projected_gates(even[2 * index + 2], odd[2 * index + 2]))
    gates.extend(short_gates(a, b, selected=True))
    gates.extend(projected_gates(0, odd[7]))
    gates.extend([((5,), h), ((6,), rotation(-math.pi / 2))])
    return gates


def replay(circuit: fq.Circuit, gates: list[Gate], inverse: bool = False) -> None:
    for wires, matrix in reversed(gates) if inverse else gates:
        circuit.any(*wires, matrix=matrix.mH if inverse else matrix)


def counter_matrix() -> torch.Tensor:
    permutation = torch.zeros((256, 256), dtype=torch.complex128)
    for word in range(256):
        output = ((word - 1) % 8) if word < 8 else word
        permutation[output, word] = 1
    return permutation


def reference_circuit(
    duration: float = 2.0,
    even: tuple[float, ...] = EVEN_PHASES,
    odd: tuple[float, ...] = ODD_PHASES,
) -> fq.Circuit:
    circuit = fq.Circuit(11, dtype=torch.complex128).h(0).h(1).x(8)
    permutation = counter_matrix()
    for index in range(4):
        replay(
            circuit,
            step_gates(index * duration / 4, (index + 1) * duration / 4, even, odd),
        )
        circuit.any(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, matrix=permutation)
    return circuit


def run_example() -> None:
    from ..main import build_program

    program = build_program()
    actual = fq.run(program).statevector().reshape(2048, 2, -1)
    expected = fq.run(reference_circuit()).statevector().flatten()
    torch.testing.assert_close(actual[:, 0, 0], expected, atol=1e-10, rtol=0)
    assert float(actual[:, 1:].abs().square().sum()) < 1e-22
    assert float(actual[:, :, 1:].abs().square().sum()) < 1e-22
    print(program.report["resources"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_example()

"""Native four-slice Magnus/QSVT time marching with a coherent counter."""

import math
from typing import Annotated

import flagquantum as fq
from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.synth import (
    RX,
    H,
    Output,
    QArray,
    QBit,
    QNum,
    R,
    adjoint,
    allocate,
    control,
    hadamard_transform,
    phase,
    qfunc,
)

from .data import EVEN_PHASES, ODD_PHASES


@qfunc
def short(
    a: float, b: float, index: QArray[QBit], time: QArray[QBit], block: QBit
) -> None:
    hadamard_transform(time)
    RX(math.pi / 2, block)
    phase(
        (2 * block - 1)
        * (a + (b - a) * (time[0] + 2 * time[1]) / 4 + index[0] + 2 * index[1]),
        1,
    )
    RX(-math.pi / 2, block)
    hadamard_transform(time)


@qfunc
def projected(
    even: float, odd: float, time: QArray[QBit], block: QBit, aux: QBit, selector: QBit
) -> None:
    phase(
        (aux - 0.5 + (1 - 2 * aux) * (1 - block) * (1 - time[0]) * (1 - time[1]))
        * (even + (odd - even) * selector),
        1,
    )


@qfunc
def final_projected(
    angle: float, time: QArray[QBit], block: QBit, aux: QBit, selector: QBit
) -> None:
    phase(
        (aux - 0.5 + (1 - 2 * aux) * (1 - block) * (1 - time[0]) * (1 - time[1]))
        * selector,
        angle,
    )


@qfunc
def step(
    even: list[float],
    odd: list[float],
    a: float,
    b: float,
    index: QArray[QBit],
    time: QArray[QBit],
    block: QBit,
    aux: QBit,
    selector: QBit,
) -> None:
    R(math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2, selector)
    H(aux)
    projected(even[0], odd[0], time, block, aux, selector)
    for i in range(3):
        short(a, b, index, time, block)
        projected(even[2 * i + 1], odd[2 * i + 1], time, block, aux, selector)
        with adjoint():
            short(a, b, index, time, block)
        projected(even[2 * i + 2], odd[2 * i + 2], time, block, aux, selector)
    control(selector, lambda: short(a, b, index, time, block))
    final_projected(odd[7], time, block, aux, selector)
    H(aux)
    R(-math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2, selector)


@qfunc
def decrement(counter: QNum) -> None:
    counter -= 1


@qfunc
def toggle_success(
    time: QArray[QBit], block: QBit, aux: QBit, selector: QBit, marker: QBit
) -> None:
    H(marker)
    phase(
        (1 - block)
        * (1 - aux)
        * (1 - selector)
        * (1 - time[0])
        * (1 - time[1])
        * marker,
        math.pi,
    )
    H(marker)


@qfunc
def main(
    even: list[float],
    odd: list[float],
    duration: float,
    index: Output[QArray[QBit]],
    time: Output[QArray[QBit]],
    block: Output[QBit],
    aux: Output[QBit],
    selector: Output[QBit],
    unused: Output[QBit],
    counter: Output[Annotated[QNum, 3]],
    marker: Output[QBit],
) -> None:
    allocate(2, index)
    allocate(2, time)
    allocate(block)
    allocate(aux)
    allocate(selector)
    allocate(unused)
    allocate(counter)
    allocate(marker)
    hadamard_transform(index)
    counter ^= 4
    for i in range(4):
        step(
            even,
            odd,
            i * duration / 4,
            (i + 1) * duration / 4,
            index,
            time,
            block,
            aux,
            selector,
        )
        toggle_success(time, block, aux, selector, marker)
        control(marker, lambda: decrement(counter))
        toggle_success(time, block, aux, selector, marker)


def classical_inputs(
    duration: float = 2.0,
    even: tuple[float, ...] = EVEN_PHASES,
    odd: tuple[float, ...] = ODD_PHASES,
) -> dict[str, list[float] | float]:
    if (
        type(duration) not in (int, float)
        or not math.isfinite(duration)
        or not 0 < duration <= 4
    ):
        raise ValueError("duration must be a finite real in (0, 4]")
    if len(even) != 7 or len(odd) != 8:
        raise ValueError("retain seven even and eight odd phases")
    if any(
        type(v) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(v) or abs(v) > 64
        for v in (*even, *odd)
    ):
        raise ValueError("phases must be finite reals in [-64, 64]")
    return {"duration": duration, "even": list(even), "odd": list(odd)}


def build_program(
    duration: float = 2.0,
    even: tuple[float, ...] = EVEN_PHASES,
    odd: tuple[float, ...] = ODD_PHASES,
) -> synth.Program:
    return synth.synthesize(
        main,
        classical_inputs=classical_inputs(duration, even, odd),
        max_qubits=20,
        max_workspace=8,
        memory_limit_bytes=64 * 1024**2,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    program = build_program()
    result = fq.run(program)
    print(dict(program.probabilities(result, registers=("index", "counter"))))
    print(program.report["resources"])

"""Compose native Magnus steps, an amplifier, and a coherent success counter."""

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from examples.synthesis.algorithms.quantum_differential_equations_solvers.time_marching.main import (
    step,
)
from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.synth import Output, QArray, QBit, allocate, qfunc

from .approximation import COMPLEX, REAL

SLICE_COUNT = 4
END = 2.0
AMPLIFIER = 7
COUNTER = (8, 9, 10)
BASE_WIDTH = 7
WIDTH = 11


@qfunc
def magnus(
    even: list[float],
    odd: list[float],
    start: float,
    end: float,
    index: Output[QArray[QBit]],
    time: Output[QArray[QBit]],
    block: Output[QBit],
    signal: Output[QBit],
    selector: Output[QBit],
) -> None:
    allocate(2, index)
    allocate(2, time)
    allocate(block)
    allocate(signal)
    allocate(selector)
    step(even, odd, start, end, index, time, block, signal, selector)


def build_slice(
    start: float,
    end: float,
    even: tuple[float, ...],
    odd: tuple[float, ...],
) -> fq.Circuit:
    program = synth.synthesize(
        magnus,
        classical_inputs={
            "start": start,
            "end": end,
            "even": [2 * x for x in even],
            "odd": [2 * x for x in odd],
        },
        max_qubits=BASE_WIDTH,
        max_workspace=0,
        max_operations=10_000,
        memory_limit_bytes=2**20,
    )
    return fq.Circuit.from_ir(program.circuit, dtype=COMPLEX)


def projector_phase(angle: float) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Phase the all-zero Magnus block with opposite signs on both signal branches."""
    basis = torch.arange(64)
    success = (basis >> 1) == 0
    positive = success == (basis % 2 == 0)
    signs = 2 * positive.to(REAL) - 1
    return torch.diag((1j * angle * signs).exp())


def counter_permutation(signal_bits: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Subtract one from the three-bit counter conditional on a zero signal word."""
    dimension = 1 << (signal_bits + len(COUNTER))
    columns = torch.arange(dimension)
    rows = columns.clone()
    rows[:8] = (columns[:8] - 1) % 8
    unitary = torch.zeros((dimension, dimension), dtype=COMPLEX)
    unitary[rows, columns] = 1
    return unitary


def assemble(
    slices: tuple[fq.Circuit, ...],
    amplitude_phases: tuple[float, ...] | None,
) -> fq.Circuit:
    """Start at counter four and decrement once on each successful slice."""
    if len(slices) != SLICE_COUNT or any(
        item.n_qubits != BASE_WIDTH for item in slices
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected four original seven-bit Magnus slices")
    if amplitude_phases is not None and len(amplitude_phases) != 8:
        raise ValueError("The degree-seven amplifier requires eight angles")
    circuit = fq.Circuit(WIDTH, dtype=COMPLEX).h(0).h(1).x(COUNTER[0])
    block = tuple(range(2, 7 if amplitude_phases is None else 8))
    decrement = counter_permutation(len(block))
    for segment in slices:
        if amplitude_phases is None:
            circuit.compose(segment, qubits=tuple(range(BASE_WIDTH)))
        else:
            adjoint = segment.adjoint()
            circuit.h(AMPLIFIER)
            circuit.any(*block, matrix=projector_phase(amplitude_phases[0]))
            for order, angle in enumerate(amplitude_phases[1:]):
                circuit.compose(
                    segment if order % 2 == 0 else adjoint,
                    qubits=tuple(range(BASE_WIDTH)),
                )
                circuit.any(*block, matrix=projector_phase(angle))
            circuit.h(AMPLIFIER)
        circuit.any(*block, *COUNTER, matrix=decrement)
    return circuit


def exact_ode(times: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    index = torch.arange(4, dtype=REAL)
    return (torch.sin(times[:, None] + index) - torch.sin(index)).exp()


def expected_block(start: float, end: float) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Exact left-Riemann slice target for the four quantum indices."""
    coordinates = torch.arange(4, dtype=REAL)[:, None]
    samples = start + torch.arange(4, dtype=REAL) * (end - start) / 4
    return (coordinates + samples).cos().mean(dim=1)
